true_new_failure_analysis.honest_summary: This order applied the promotion correctly at the authority level -- the counts derive, the contracts agree, only Indianapolis moved in the globals and the assembled candidate is clean with one non-zero market delta. But it wrote three structures without reading their schemas first, and left the rebuilt partition unwired. Those are this order's defects, not pre-existing ones.
